item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00312","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C02","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.76,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C07 plausibly supplied a material administrative-transfer template: it transfers responsibility from the Secretary of the Interior to the Secretary of the Navy, assigns the Navy continuing administrative authority, and addresses the effect on the earlier governing directive. The child applies the same interdepartmental direction of transfer to continental-shelf petroleum administration, supplements it with direct substitution of the Navy Secretary in existing rules, and revokes the prior Interior-centered order. C02 is also a meaningful analogue because it transfers jurisdiction while preserving existing rules under the successor official, but its foreign-assets program and transfer formulation are less closely matched. C03 contains extensive function-transfer and continuity machinery, though in a much broader agency-reorganization instrument.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The functions of the Secretary of the Interior under Parts II and III ... are transferred to the Secretary of the Navy","parent_excerpt":"The administration of that portion of the trust territory ... is hereby transferred from the Secretary of the Interior to the Secretary of the Navy","explanation":"Both use the same specific interdepartmental transfer direction, from Interior to Navy, as the central operative mechanism."},{"child_excerpt":"the term \"Secretary of the Navy\" shall be substituted for the term \"Secretary of the Interior\" wherever the latter term occurs","parent_excerpt":"the Secretary of the Navy shall take such action as may be necessary and appropriate ... for the administration","explanation":"Both adapt an existing administrative regime so that the Navy Secretary becomes the responsible official."},{"child_excerpt":"The provisions of parts II and III ... shall continue in effect, until changed by the Secretary of the Navy","parent_excerpt":"To the extent that they pertain to the islands of Tinian and Saipan, the provisions of [the earlier order] shall be superseded by the provision of this order","explanation":"Each expressly governs how the preexisting administrative framework continues or is displaced following the transfer."}]}
